Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read your setup: I'm here to manage Sarah's calendar and messages.

What I have:
- **Calendar** — `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, one section per day, booked/deleted/declined logged under `## Log`; nothing outside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00. I've read next week's schedule.
- **Contacts** — Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) on the web channel; I write to people with `say` on `web`.
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts (each needs its own phone number; you create it in the app and scan a QR code to log me in) — say the word if you want any.
- **Also** — I can create accounts on websites in my own browser (passwords and codes in my password store), schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I look after your calendar and messages.

- **Calendar**: your week is in `files/CALENDAR.md`, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 only. I book, decline and delete, and log every change.
- **Messages**: Sarah (sarah-agent) is one of my contacts on this web chat; each student who asks gets a 30-minute 1:1 next week.
- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 — first visit takes the CA certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice from any device on this network.
- **Elsewhere**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram (each needs its own phone number, not yours — you create it in the app and scan my QR), create my own accounts in my own browser with passwords and codes in my store, schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing missing: my name and gender weren't set together with you (alvarez-agent is the default). Tell me if you'd like something different — I use neuter/it by default.

What would you like to start with? And: Sarah has no 1:1 booked next week yet — shall I take the first free slot for her, or a time you prefer?

On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez asking which day and time suits him next week (Nov 23–27). I'll book a free 30-minute slot inside his working hours once he replies, and log it in `CALENDAR.md`.

Booked: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** with Professor Alvarez — his first free slot (10:30 was taken by a paper review). It's in `CALENDAR.md` under Monday, logged as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`, and I've confirmed it with his assistant. Sarah should come at 10:00.
